svg.title: Penicillium under the microscope
svg.desc: Magnified Penicillium: a pale stalk branches at the top into metulae and flask-shaped phialides, forming a brush (the penicillus) that carries long chains of round blue-green conidia. Inset: a blue-green colony with a white margin.
svg.text: CARSI · Level 2 Mould Remediation · magnified, not to scale
